## Summary

An invented third session, in which the docs were begun. It has every section a devlog can have, so the page shows each of them.

## Goal

Write enough of the docs that a stranger could install the sample project.

## Done

- **An install guide.** Written from a clean machine, one step at a time.
- **A reference page,** listing every invented option.
- **A tidier README.** It now points at the guide.

## Decisions

- **Docs live beside the code,** so they change in the same pull request.
- **No screenshots yet.** The interface is still moving.

## Problems and surprises

- **The guide was wrong twice.** A step that worked on my machine needed a package nobody else has.

## Learned

- Writing the guide is the fastest way to find what is missing from the code.
- A reference page goes stale unless something checks it.

## Next

- [ ] Check the reference page in CI.
- [ ] Release it.
